response.sql: WITH per_rating AS (SELECT rating, AVG(rental_rate * 1.0 / rental_duration) AS avg_ratio, COUNT(*) AS film_count FROM film WHERE rental_duration > 5 GROUP BY rating), bench AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS benchmark FROM per_rating) SELECT p.rating, p.avg_ratio, p.film_count, p.avg_ratio / b.benchmark AS ratio_to_benchmark FROM per_rating p CROSS JOIN bench b WHERE b.benchmark IS NOT NULL

assumptions.assumption: Ratings with a NULL rating value are grouped as their own group (none expected per the verified data); the benchmark averages the per-rating averages equally (unweighted), and a rating whose average is NULL is ignored in the benchmark.
The number of films is COUNT(*) of the films in each rating group with rental_duration > 5, including films whose per-film ratio is missing.
